purpose: Korean shopping/product-recommendation Shorts (owner 2026-09-28 '쇼핑쇼츠들 분석하고 온톨로지에 원본영상 데이터 수집가능하게 확장해놔'): what format and hooks earn views, how they are monetized, and where their footage comes from (the original video, when it can be found publicly). Used to plan OUR shorts, never to reuse other creators' footage.

policy.stored: public metadata (title, description links, hashtags, counts, dates), creator-authored comment links, storyboard frame dHashes (64-bit), provenance edges with evidence
policy.notStored: video/audio files, full frames, commenter identities or comment text of viewers
policy.reuse: footage found here is a technique/provenance reference only; our videos use own footage, licensed/official assets with permission, stock with a commercial license, or AI generation (shorts-production-guide.v1.json)
policy.access: anonymous public YouTube web (results, channel shorts tab, watch page, storyboard images, youtubei/v1/next comments continuation). Douyin, TikTok and Instagram need a login or redirect to a shell anonymously: their originals are recorded as notCollectable with the cue that points there, or added by hand as a URL (manualCandidate).
policy.rate: sequential requests with a delay (default 1.2 s); stop on a consent/challenge page (YOUTUBE_CHALLENGE)

provenanceCues.description: ≥2 storyboard frames within Hamming ≤10 of an older public video.
The same frames appear in Shorts of other channels in one scan (footageClusters): footage from a common outside source.
Description/title names a foreign maker country (sites are usually filmed there).
Latin/Japanese/Chinese product hashtag: the search term of the origin market.
Aggregator title formulas (천재가 만든, 신박한, 미친) with no own-use wording.
Paid promotion disclosure (description, title, or YouTube paid-promotion flag).
Neutral; views-only channels (Shorts fund / later sponsorship).

methodReferences.ourUse: format/monetization reference only: the footage model reuses other creators' reviews (copyright + YouTube reused-content risk, and 3rd-party review use is banned by 토스 쉐어링크 policy). Our equivalent: own footage or brand-permitted assets + shopping tag.
methodReferences.evidenceLimit: description and chapters only; the transcript endpoint needs a token that anonymous requests do not have (timedtext empty, get_transcript 400)
